MULTI::Sal:Zephyr|Rex:Zephyr:::TTS the following conversation between Sal and Rex. Director's Note: AM 670 The Score Screamer Meltdown. Sal is Sal (Zephyr). Co-host is Rex (Zephyr).

TTS the following conversation between Sal and Rex:
Sal: Sal: [booming coach shout] I am sick to my stomach! [groans in disgust] Eleven guys in dis Initech pool took da Rams, Rex! Eleven! One hundred fourteen confidence points flushed right down da sewer grate on 35th Street! And Shoeman... [screams in disbelief] Shoeman burned his sixteen-point number-one anchor! His ceiling is capped at one-twenty! You don't put sixteen points on an indoor team wit' no lead fullback! Dis is what happens when you don't respect trench warfare!
Rex: Rex: [boisterous Texas drawl] [hearty belly laugh] Aw, calm your blood pressure down, Sal, you're gonna curdle the au jus! Shoeman took a shot on an elite aerial attack and took some buckshot to the chest, that's just big-time Texas high-roller football! But how about Orange Crush, partner? Sittin' pretty in first place with twenty-six points like a king at a tailgate! Only man alive who had the brass to take San Francisco for ten whole points!
Sal: Sal: [clears throat] [shouting with passion] Don't you start praisin' blind luck, cowboy! Orange Crush got lucky on a busted screen pass! You wanna see real football grit? Look at PatN—lost exactly one point on da Rams! Preserved a league-best one-thirty-five max ceiling! Dat is disciplined game management! And you look at Todd Reimer—sitting at eight points, but he hasn't touched his top seven anchors! Chargers sixteen! Jags fifteen! Lions fourteen! [dramatic pause] Dat is a freight train waitin' on da tracks!
Rex: Rex: [boisterous laugh] [chuckles warmly] Freight train? Sal, the man's name on the ticker is 'CramItUp Your CramHole Lafleur' and he has eight measly points on the scoreboard! You're backin' a turtle in a quarter-horse race! Sure, he's got Jim Harbaugh's ground attack locked at sixteen, but if Herbert's arm goes cold or Detroit forgets how to air it out, that whole hundred-and-twenty-seven-point runway goes up in smoke like dry mesquite!
Sal: Sal: [booming coach shout] Smoke?! [groans in disgust] Ground-and-pound don't go up in smoke, Rex! Jim Harbaugh is gonna run da rock right down da throat of whoever steps on dat field! Meanwhile, Niner Faithful picked against his own Frisco squad for eleven points and got humiliated on national television! [shouting with passion] Fourteen games left! Todd's comin' for first place, and when he hits, I'm dippin' three beefs extra juicy! Line 'em up!
